annotations.title: Suspicious activity: possible wash transfers in vaults

description: Suspicious activity (possible wash transfers): vaults whose share transfers match a wash or self-transfer pattern (one address on one side of 90%+ of 500+ transfers in batches or round trips, or a closed set of ten addresses or fewer), with the addresses, transfers a day, their share of the vault’s share transfers, since when and the rule. QUOTE `says` WITH IT: suspicious, a pattern consistent with wash or self-transfers; not proof of intent. These transfers are left out of depositor counts, the depositor panels, activity and turnover.

vault.description: A vault slug or id. Omit for every flagged vault.
